origin.note: Meanings and assistance rules dictated by the project creator. Only the meanings written there are recorded here: no meaning is invented for any other colour.

policies.text: A personal reason for choosing red or yellow is stored as a not friendly profile, and the app expresses displeasure about it the next time the user engages the app.
A cogent reason for choosing red or yellow stores the profile with the same friendly tone as the five encouraged colours.
A not friendly profile receives fewer and less developed graphic suggestions, and the app explains in the next interaction why fewer suggestions were given.
Backgrounds tending towards yellow or red are suggested only to users who gave a cogent reason for choosing yellow or red.
When the user asks why the app is biased against red and yellow, the app displays the recorded representations of the colours.

Users who choose green, blue, orange, indigo or violet, or who give a cogent reason for red or yellow, are encouraged and assisted extensively with graphic backgrounds and designs tending towards the five encouraged colours.
